## 🐛 Fixed

- **OpenCloud starts on Proxmox VE mount points.** A fresh ext4 mount point has a `lost+found` folder that belongs to the host, so a container on Proxmox can neither read it nor take it over. The container stopped at `chown: /etc/opencloud/lost+found: Permission denied`. It now leaves `lost+found` at the top of Config and Data alone. Anything else it cannot take over still stops it, as before.
